records.title: MLE-STAR: Machine Learning Engineering Agent via Search and Targeted Refinement
records.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 PDF page1 explicitly assigns Jaehyun Nam to Google Cloud and KAIST, with a student-researcher-at-Google-Cloud note; Jinsung Yoon/Jiefeng Chen/Sercan Ö.Arık/Tomas Pfister are Google Cloud.
records.date_evidence: Abs submission history, citation_date and fixed-v1 PDF page1 all say27May2025; the identifier month is not used as a date.
records.method_summary: Search retrieves task-specific models; candidates are trained/scored on validation and merged only if improved. An ablation selects a high-impact not-yet-refined code block; inner plan/refinement evaluations update the best replacement and outer loops repeat. Ensemble search and leakage/data-usage checks are distinct additional agents.
records.cost_basis: AppendixF:96vCPU/360GB RAM/eight16GBV100 GPUs;14.1hours average per final solution over22competitions×3trials;24h task cap. This is a published configuration, not a local measurement.
records.code_status: The paper-linked author repository exposes example_final_solutions and example_intermediate_outputs; these are generated artifacts, not a complete controller. The current root README contains only a title. Google's official blog links an ADK sample, but its exact raw README returned 404 in this bounded check; current complete source availability is not overclaimed.

records.title: DS-STAR: Data Science Agent for Solving Diverse Tasks across Heterogeneous Formats and Open-Ended Queries
title_aliases: DS-STAR: Data Science Agent via Iterative Planning and Verification
records.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 PDF page 1 assigns first author Jaehyun Nam to Google Cloud and KAIST and notes a Google Cloud student-research placement. Google Cloud coauthors and KAIST's Jinwoo Shin are explicitly labeled. This resolves an affiliation omitted by the HTML conversion.
records.method_summary: An analyzer writes/executes scripts to describe heterogeneous files. The verifier judges plan sufficiency from query,plan,code and execution output. If insufficient, router either appends or truncates at a mistaken step before replanning; semantic judging is an external model responsibility, not a deterministic controller capability.
records.cost_basis: AppendixC measures ten development tasks:12.7model calls,154669input tokens and USD0.23 average per task using Gemini2.5Pro. AppendixB lists450DABStep,104KramaBench and500DA-Code tasks; main configuration allows20rounds and adds baseline/ablation/API work. The per-task number alone is not classified as an expensive GPU training run; total full-suite time is not disclosed.
records.cost_limitation: A deterministic controller is affordable; a faithful semantic agent and complete hidden-label/API benchmark need separate bounded implementation/cost disposition, not an invented local timing.
records.code_status: Current official Google Research repository is available at commit 6c05b01e30f01489af12708e99eda932e44d10ba. The checked README now uses the revised title and includes DSSTAR+; that later implementation is not silently substituted for the fixed-v1 algorithm. Independent IBM/OpenDsStar and JulesLscx/DS-Star remain distinct community implementations.
records.low_cost_boundary: Exact append/truncate/replan execution state with external analyzer/coder/verifier/router ports; no gold labels or hidden benchmark answers exposed to actors.

records.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
records.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 PDF page1 assigns the author team to Google DeepMind.
records.method_summary: A task-specific evaluator, sampled code/context, Gemini2.0Flash/Pro proposals, evaluation cascades and multi-score evolutionary database interact in an asynchronous distributed pipeline. The database is inspired by MAP-Elites and islands; the paper does not fully specify a unique replacement implementation.
records.cost_basis: Section2.4 permits roughly100compute-hours for evaluation of a new candidate and distributes evaluations over a cluster; sections3.1-3.3 cover many mathematical targets and production-specificGoogle compute kernels/circuits. Single-A100/A30 capacity cannot reproduce the disclosed complete pipeline/engineering matrix cheaply.
records.code_status: Official repository contains discovered constructions and correctness-checking notebook only; README explicitly excludes code to runAlphaEvolve. OpenEvolve or other community controllers are not the original system.

records.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 byline explicitly includes first-authorEserAygün/GoogleDeepMind and numerousGoogleResearch authors includingMichaelP.Brenner; some authors additionally listMIT/Harvard/McGill/Caltech.
records.method_summary: Flat selection across all executed candidate nodes uses rank-normalized task score plus uniform-priorPUCT exploration, with ancestor visit backpropagation. Generated code is separately executed in a sandbox against the task metric. Research-idea injection and recombination are additional stages, not provided by a UCB scalar alone.
records.cost_basis: 500-node scRNA-seq searches take about7hours on original infrastructure;COVID-19 runs use2000nodes;unifiedGIFT-Eval uses1000+nodes and another500-node refinement. These are published counts/times, not a local probe.

Fixed-v1 CodeAvailability described generated solutions/tree views under google-research/score; publication, later rename and current source release are distinguished.
records.low_cost_boundary: CPUAlgorithm1 over explicit external generate/execute functions. Current upstream singletonrank0.5/rootvisit0 differs from paperAlgorithm1 singletonrank1/rootvisit1, so select and document a fixed semantic target rather than silently mixing versions.
